claim_text: In children with NF1 and symptomatic plexiform neurofibromas treated with selumetinib, progression-free survival was 84% at 3 years after treatment start, and median progression-free survival was not reached.
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. PFS outcome, same CHEBI:90227->MONDO:0003304 edge.
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
